note: Track breath, step 5 (hiss, then buzz): one breathwork circle with the "sss-zzz" drill at its own lengths; each sound gets its own sound clause, and the feel to reach is air at one speed as the voice comes in and goes out. The advanced block of this drill stays separate, because its breathwork is set longer and a choice can't change a tool's seconds.

exercise.title: Hiss, then buzz
exercise.why: A hiss is air alone and a buzz is the same air with your voice added, so going from one to the other shows how little extra push a note needs.

cells.text:
Press Start in the circle below. Hiss on "sss" as the circle shows, then add your voice and buzz on "zzz", then hiss again.
When the rounds are done, press Again in the circle to run them once more.
Practice until the air moves at the same speed through all three sounds.
